messages.content: What is the Chat System module?

The Chat System (id: chat) is one of Jarvis's core modules. It provides 3 API endpoints. POST /api/chat with body { 'message': 'Hello Jarvis', 'userId': 'shawn' }. Returns { reply: '...' }. The message goes through runJarvisAgent which calls Google Gemini AI with system prompt, conversational history, and optional visual data.
How do I use the POST /api/chat endpoint?
POST /api/chat: Main AI chat. Body: { message, history?, visualData?, userId?, accessToken? }. Returns: { reply }
How do I use the GET /api/chat-history endpoint?
GET /api/chat-history: Return chat history. Headers: x-user-id. Returns: [{ id, role, content, timestamp }]
How do I use the POST /api/chat-history/clear endpoint?
POST /api/chat-history/clear: Clear chat history. Headers: x-user-id.
How do I chat with you?

POST /api/chat with body { 'message': 'Hello Jarvis', 'userId': 'shawn' }. Returns { reply: '...' }. The message goes through runJarvisAgent which calls Google Gemini AI with system prompt, conversational history, and optional visual data.
What happens when the Gemini API quota is exhausted?

The chat handler detects 429/RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED errors and returns: 'My apologies, Boss. It appears my core thinking matrix has exhausted the Gemini API's free request quota. Standing by on standby power.'
Chat loads core memory for user profile, then retrieves chat history (up to 50 messages), and sends the full context to the AI model for generation.
What errors can occur in the Chat System module?
Errors: 400 if no message, 500 on API failure (with graceful error reply), 429 when Gemini quota exhausted
How does the Chat System module integrate with other Jarvis modules?
Chat reads Memory for context, writes to Chat History, and can trigger Skills, Swarm Delegation, and Web Analysis.
